flashbackinspector.screen.title: Inventory in the replay
flashbackinspector.not_sent: A server never sends another player's inventory to the client
flashbackinspector.not_recorded: This replay was made without the mod – the rest is not in it
flashbackinspector.no_target: Nobody selected – spectate a player first
flashbackinspector.log.title: Containers opened
flashbackinspector.log.empty: No containers were opened in this recording.
flashbackinspector.config.title: Flashback Inspector
flashbackinspector.config.no_cloth: Install Cloth Config for search and categories
flashbackinspector.option.record_invento: Put your inventory and worn items into the replay. Off, new recordings go without it; recordings already made are unaffected.
flashbackinspector.option.record_contain: Put the contents of chests and other containers you open yourself into the replay. Containers opened by others are never sent to your client.
Ticks between two looks at the inventory. Only changed slots are written, so looking every tick is cheap and catches an item that passes through a slot for a single tick.
flashbackinspector.option.replace_invent: In a replay, the inventory key opens this screen instead of the spectator's empty one.
flashbackinspector.option.container_mode: Manual: the container waits in the inventory screen until you open it. Follow: it opens and closes by itself, on the ticks it did during the recording. While any screen is up, Flashback's editor stops taking the mouse.
flashbackinspector.option.container_hint: A line above the hotbar while the recording has a container open.
flashbackinspector.option.pause_when_ope: Stop playback when the inventory opens, so the contents hold still while they are read.
Time and tick number in the corner, so a screenshot says for itself which moment it is of.
